title: Ben van Kerkwijk on the Hawara labyrinth and ancient accounts

tellings.quote: What do you think of you know Ben van Kerkwijk? He just went on Joe Rogan's show and he talks about this large labyrinth The huge labyrinth like Hawara region and

plain: A huge labyrinth, a maze of buildings, once stood in the Hawara region of Egypt, and the researcher Ben van Kerkwijk talks about it, drawing on accounts by the ancient Greek historian Herodotus and the Roman writer Pliny the Elder. Michels raises this with a scientist who has scanned beneath the pyramids, noting that van Kerkwijk had just described it on the show of the podcaster Joe Rogan. If true, it would point to a vast lost structure still hidden under the Egyptian sand.
